title: tables no blank cells
rule: Tables: no blank cells; split complex tables. Every column/row has a header; cell value relates to both. If empty: notes/legend or “no data” / “0” / “n/a” — never a silent blank. Convert simple data to a list; never nested subheads inside a column.
pass_when: Headers on rows/columns; empty values are named (“no data” / “0” / “n/a” / legend); simple data is a list; no nested subheads in a column.
fail_when: Silent blank cells; missing headers; nested subheads in a column.
apply_when: Table or card grid for this data
not_when: Not for controls inside a form, or density on a form.
agent_hint: Tables: no blank cells; split complex tables.
description: Tables: no blank cells; split complex tables. Headers on rows/columns. It fails when Silent blank cells.
do_not_claim: NSW chart data-table anatomy as this row.
